# Index expressions may allocate and compact arrays without losing their temporary base.
[9][len(push([0], 1))-2] => 9
push([8], 9)[len(push([0], 1))-2] => 8
{ [42] }[len(concat([0], [1]))-2] => 42
fn make() { [7] }; make()[len(push([0], 1))-2] => 7
let a = [9]; a[len(push([0], 1))-2] => 9
1 && [9][len(push([0], 1))-2] => 1
0 && [9][len(push([0], 1))-2] => 0
[9][len(push([0], 1))-1] => error:array index out of bounds
[9][len(push([0], 1))- => error:expected integer
[9][len(push([0], 1))-2 => error:expected closing bracket
